title: End-to-End CI/CD Pipeline for Web Application
shortDesc: Automated build, test, and deployment pipeline triggered on every GitHub commit.
fullDesc: Designed and implemented an automated CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins for application build, testing, and deployment. Configured GitHub Webhooks to trigger automated builds and deployments on every code commit. Containerized the application using Docker to ensure consistent deployment across multiple environments, and automated deployments on Linux servers using Bash scripting to replace manual deployment processes.
highlights: Designed & implemented automated CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins for build, test & deploy
Configured GitHub Webhooks for automated builds triggered on every code commit
Containerized application using Docker for environment consistency across stages
Automated Linux server deployments using Bash scripting
Replaced manual deployment process, cutting down on repetitive steps & human error

title: Infrastructure Automation Using Ansible & AWX
shortDesc: Automated Linux server provisioning and configuration management using Playbooks.
fullDesc: Automated Linux server provisioning and configuration using reusable Ansible Playbooks. Managed inventories, credentials, job templates, and workflow automation through AWX. Automated package installation, user management, service configuration, and application deployment by developing modular YAML playbooks following infrastructure automation best practices.
highlights: Automated Linux server provisioning & configuration using reusable Ansible Playbooks
Managed inventories, credentials, job templates & workflow automation via AWX
Automated package installation, user management, service config & app deployment
Developed modular YAML playbooks following IaC automation best practices
Standardized server configurations across environments, eliminating manual setup error

title: Dockerized Three-Tier Web Application
shortDesc: Containerized frontend, backend, and database services with reverse proxy.
fullDesc: Built and deployed a containerized three-tier web application consisting of frontend, backend, and database services. Managed multi-container environments using Docker Compose, configured Docker networking, persistent storage, and service communication. Implemented Nginx as a reverse proxy for efficient request routing across development and testing environments.
highlights: Built & deployed containerized 3-tier web app (frontend, backend, database)
Managed multi-container environment orchestration using Docker Compose
Configured Docker custom networking, persistent storage & service communication
Implemented Nginx as a reverse proxy for efficient request routing
Standardized application deployment across dev and testing environments

title: AI-Powered Person Detection & Tracking System
shortDesc: Real-time person detection and tracking using computer vision techniques.
fullDesc: Developed a desktop-based application for real-time person detection and tracking using computer vision techniques (YOLO & OpenCV). Designed a modular architecture to improve scalability and maintainability, optimized image processing workflows to enhance application performance, and containerized the application using Docker for consistent execution.
highlights: Real-time person detection & tracking using YOLO object model + OpenCV
Designed modular architecture to improve application scalability & maintainability
Optimized image processing workflows for high-frame-rate computer vision performance
Containerized application using Docker for consistent execution across environments
Managed project codebase using Git following version control best practices
